ITC Midwest and ATC each built and operate their own segment, so it could instead be split into two owner-specific packages (east operational Dec 2023, west Sept 2024). projects.summary: A 345 kV line approved by the Wisconsin PSC in docket 5-CE-142 (Final Decision dated April 23, 2015) from the Briggs Road Substation in the town of Onalaska north through Holmen and the city of Blair, then southeast along I-94 and I-90/94 to the North Madison Substation and on to the Cardinal Substation in the town of Middleton; ATC and NSPW (Xcel Energy) were the applicants, with DPC, SMMPA Wisconsin and WPPI as tenants-in-common on the Briggs Road-North Madison segment. route.description: Text-described approved route (no map digitized): the PSC certificated Segments P (P-east), N, M, K, H (H6-north), G, E, D and A. Per the decision's segment descriptions, the line runs north from Briggs Road Substation (town of Onalaska) through Holmen along USH 53, across the Black River, north into Trempealeau County to the city of Blair, east toward Black River Falls, then southeast along I-94 past the Camp Douglas vicinity to just north of Lyndon Station, along I-90/94 past Wisconsin Dells toward the I-90/94 / I-39 intersection (town of Caledonia area), across the Wisconsin River, from the town of Dekorra to the town of Vienna and the North Madison Substation, then to the town of Springfield and the Cardinal Substation.
route.caveat: schematic / not survey accurate; waypoints are towns/facilities named in the PSC decision's descriptions of the approved segments, geocoded to locality centroids or OSM substations; straight lines between them do not show the actual alignment; the as-built alignment was not checked against the 2015 decision
